text:
maria_support: @sam_engineering customer reports tool-call failing intermittently during streaming. payload arrives but tool args end up as truncated JSON -> schema validation error. stack says 400 invalid tool args.

sam_engineering: can you paste the truncated payload? any pattern to where it cuts off?

customer-jones: here's the wire snippet we captured from our client. last chunk is cut off mid-object:
```
{
  \"tool\": \"charge\",
  \"args\": {
    \"order_id\": \"ord_9xY3\",
    \"amount\": 4900,
    \"metadata\": {
      \"user\": \"jones\"
    }
  // <--- stream ends here, no closing braces
```

maria_support: thanks. customer says it happens when they have streaming enabled and their mobile app backgrounding triggers a network reattach.

kai_infra: could be our SSE/keepalive split behaviour. sometimes the keepalive chunk boundary can occur inside the JSON if client pauses then resumes. will check the proxy chunking logs.

sam_engineering: reproduce attempt: send a POST with Transfer-Encoding: chunked and insert a 1s pause mid-body, see if args get truncated on our side. also try HTTP/2 with a stalled DATA frame.

alex_prod: we should confirm whether this is client-abort (missing trailing bytes) or server-side drop (we received but didn't append). any tcpdump/edge logs from the time window?

customer-jones: attached pcap in the support ticket (link). i can repro locally by toggling network off then back on while streaming the toolcall.

kai_infra: looking at edge logs for that window — there is a keepalive chunk inserted by the load balancer every 15s. i see a sequence where a keepalive chunk ("\n") was forwarded between application chunks which could split JSON tokens.

sam_engineering: interesting. splitting is okay if reassembly is on, but if intermediate agent interprets keepalive as end-of-message (or our SSE parser stops at first valid JSON object), that'll truncate. do we parse incremental JSON for tool args?

kai_infra: our streaming parser buffers until a full top-level event, but tool args arrive inside the stream as nested JSON objects. hypothesis: when keepalive chunk arrives mid-object, downstream framing treats it as an event boundary and attempts to parse partial JSON -> validation error.

maria_support: customer workaround requested — what can they change on their side short-term?

sam_engineering: short term: 1) avoid backgrounding the client during a toolcall (disable aggressive disconnects), 2) encode args as base64 or a single string so the streaming layer sees no nested braces, 3) send tool args in the initial non-streaming request (no streaming).

alex_prod: longer term we should make parser resilient to keepalive/gap insertions: treat keepalive-only chunks as transparent and always merge adjacent chunks before JSON parse. add a checksum or explicit length prefix for tool args.

kai_infra: i'm going to add a quick metric to detect toolcall-args-parse-failures correlated with keepalive boundaries and surface in Console alerts so we can measure impact.

sam_engineering: can you also attach the small reproducer script here? i'll run it against staging.

kai_infra: posted reproducer gist: curl --no-buffer -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.com/v1/stream -H 'Transfer-Encoding: chunked' -d $'{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"start"}],"tool_call":{"name":"charge","args":' && sleep 1 && printf '%s' '{"order_id":"ord_9xY3","amount":4900}}'

maria_support: copying this thread to eng-infra channel and escalating with customer case id #CASE-5231. @alex_prod please prioritize if we see >5% of production calls affected.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-5231 - streaming tool args truncated during keepalive boundary.

customer-jones: thanks all. let me know if you want any additional traces from our side.

sam_engineering: next steps: (1) kai add alert + edge log grep, (2) i'll run reproducer in staging and attach server-side raw frames, (3) alex evaluate parser hardening options and estimate. will update by EOD. :thumbsup:
